requirements.text: Have strong full-stack software engineering fundamentals and experience building polished, production-grade user experiences.
Are comfortable working across frontend and backend systems, ideally with technologies such as React, TypeScript, Python, Go, or similar tools.
Have experience building onboarding, activation, growth, collaboration, discovery, or developer-product experiences.
Care deeply about user experience and can turn ambiguous customer problems into simple, intuitive product flows.
Enjoy working across product, design, engineering, analytics, and customer-facing teams.
Are comfortable using data, experimentation, and user feedback to guide product decisions.
Enjoy 0 → 1 environments, move quickly through ambiguity, and bring strong product judgment to technical trade-offs.
